About Swat Tourism

We are dedicated to providing unforgettable experiences in the beautiful Swat Valley. With over 10 years of experience, we offer the best guided tours, accommodations, and travel services.

Your Gateway to Swat's Natural Beauty

Founded in 2013, Swat Tourism has been the leading tour operator in the region, helping thousands of travelers discover the magic of Swat Valley. Our mission is to promote sustainable tourism while preserving the natural beauty and cultural heritage of the area.

We offer a wide range of services including guided tours, custom itineraries, accommodation bookings, transportation, and authentic cultural experiences. Our team of local experts ensures that every journey is safe, enjoyable, and memorable.

Expert Guides

Our certified local guides have in-depth knowledge of Swat's history and culture.

Small Groups

We keep our tour groups small for a more personalized experience.

Flexible Scheduling

Customize your itinerary to match your preferences and available time.

Customer Satisfaction

We pride ourselves on our 98% customer satisfaction rate.

Popular Destinations in Swat

Explore the most breathtaking locations in Swat Valley, from serene lakes and majestic mountains to historic sites and cultural landmarks.

Kalam

Upper Swat Valley

A scenic valley with lush forests, meadows, and waterfalls.

Mahodand Lake

Ushu Valley, Swat

A beautiful alpine lake surrounded by snow-capped mountains.

Malam Jabba

Swat Valley

Pakistan's premier ski resort with stunning mountain views.

Swat Museum

Saidu Sharif, Swat

Home to Gandhara art and artifacts from the region's rich history.

Mangora

Swat Valley

The commercial hub of Swat with vibrant markets and culture.

Bahrain

Swat Valley

A charming town known for its riverside restaurants and natural beauty.
